message: 避けられぬ決戦

name: Sally
message: 「Do we really have to fight Azel?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Yes. If we don't, Azel-san will be swallowed up by Re-Crea.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Still, Re-Crea's power is crazy strong, right? Can we even win?」

name: Ria
message: 「Timing-wise, it hasn't reached its critical point yet...」

name: Ria
message: 「Besides, Melilot-san said we'll be fine since we destroyed the magic circle amplifying the energy.」

name: Synn
message: 「If we combine the strength of us Crusaders, we should be able to overcome Re-Crea's solitary power.」

name: Shio
message: 「Even if we win, whether Lady Azel's body will emerge unscathed is...」

name: Synn
message: 「If Azel has resolved herself, then we have to resolve ourselves too.」

name: Misa
message: 「Exactly. If we get cold feet now, the whole world is going to be in big trouble.」

name: Riesling
message: 「My lady. You should already understand Lady Azel's wish.」

name: Amyrina
message: 「There is no longer any need to hesitate, Lolotte. You have always carved your own path with your very own hands.」

name: Amyrina
message: 「Have courage. Our strength... our bonds... All the knowledge and experience we could never have gained in Heaven will--」

name: Synn
message: 「--definitely become our strength.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「We will defeat Re-Crea. No matter what!!」

name: Helena
message: 「Let's go. Azel-chan is waiting for us!」
Stars streaming endlessly across the sky.
At the foot of the tower, a lone girl stood motionless, gazing up at them.

name: Azel
message: 「How... beautiful.」

name: Azel
message: 「How ironic. To think that the light leading the world to ruin would be so breathtaking...」

name: Azel
message: 「Even if I find it a pity, as long as the shooting stars do not vanish... Re-Crea will continue to exist within me.」

name: Azel
message: 「Even if I do not wish for it, so long as Re-Crea demands it, I have no choice but to initiate the rebirth.」

name: Azel
message: 「If only I possessed a stronger heart, I would never have been consumed by Re-Crea in the first place.」

name: Azel
message: 「My heart was far too empty, so it ended up being filled」

name: Azel
message: 「Lolotte... If only I had met you a little sooner... things wouldn't have come to this...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Azel-san. Do you already intend to lose?」

name: Azel
message: 「What did you say...?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「With such half-hearted resolve, do you truly think Re-Crea will give up!!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Azel-san! I will protect the world, and I will save you too!」

name: Azel
message: 「You mean... you'll hold back?」

name: Synn
message: 「Give everything our all... both fighting Azel and saving Azel!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Therefore, Azel-san... in order to fulfill both your wish and Re-Crea's wish...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Please come at us with everything you have as well!」

name: Azel
message: 「...Understood」

name: Azel
message: 「Even if Re-Crea is incomplete, even without relying on its immense power, I still have my own strength!」

name: Azel
message: 「And I have my own will. To see that will through... I won't let any of you get in my way!」

name: Synn
message: 「Let's go, Azel! We're ending everything right here!」
